snippet.title: *NEW* Mysterious Ancient Structures Found #history
snippet.description:
In 2002, archaeologists Joanne Clarke and Nick Brooks began fieldwork in the Western Sahara. Their research, combined with satellite imagery and drone surveys, revealed over a thousand ancient stone monuments scattered across the desert. These included corridors, rings, upright slabs, and one structure stretching approximately 630 meters in length.

Some formations were aligned in geometric patterns or spiraled into enclosed spaces, indicating deliberate construction and potential ceremonial or social functions. Radiocarbon dating suggests some of these structures are over 5,000 years old, dating back to a time when the Sahara was a green, habitable landscape.

This discovery raises important questions about prehistoric civilizations in North Africa and what other archaeological evidence might still lie buried beneath the sands of the Sahara.

Dive into the fascinating world of Biblical Archaeology with our latest video: "The Top 10 Biblical Archaeology Discoveries"! 2: The Merneptah Stele: Witness the earliest non-biblical mention of Israel and its implications for biblical history.

3: The Pool of Siloam: Explore the site where Jesus performed one of his miracles, as mentioned in the New Testament.

4: Megiddo (Armageddon): Delve into the history of this ancient city, known for its strategic importance and biblical significance.

5: Capernaum: Walk through the ancient fishing village central to Jesus' ministry.

6: The Black Obelisk of Shalmaneser III: See the depiction of Jehu, king of Israel, and understand its significance in biblical studies.

7: The Mesha Stele: Learn about King Mesha of Moab's victories over the Israelites, as recorded on this ancient stone.

8: The Amarna Letters: Discover how these tablets provide context for the biblical narrative, especially during the era of Joshua and Judges.

9: The Caiaphas Ossuary: Examine the bone box associated with the high priest Caiaphas, known for his role in the trial of Jesus.

10: The Ancient City of Nineveh: Revisit the city central to the story of Jonah in the Bible.

snippet.title: Archaeologists make ‘once-in-a-century’ discovery at Pompeii | BBC News
snippet.description:
A "once-in-a-century" find has been unearthed in Pompeii after lying hidden for more than 2,000 years.
 
Archaeologists discovered a private bathhouse - potentially the largest ever found there - complete with hot, warm and cold rooms, exquisite artwork, and even a huge plunge pool.
 
The skeletons of a woman and a man were found in the house - the former discovered clutching a bag of coins and jewellery.
 
They had barricaded themselves into a small room, but were killed as a tsunami of superheated volcanic gas and ash - known as a pyroclastic flow - ripped through the town.
